Marshall & Dominguez LLP
Pearland, TX
Phone 281-555-1704
Settlement Demand
June 25, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1233 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our firm represents Warren Fletcher in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on December 27,
2023. Our client was lawfully turning left at an intersection when your insured's vehicle struck the driver's side of our
client's car. The police report and the physical damage to both vehicles support our client's account that the collision
was caused by your insured's failure to yield the right of way.
As a direct result of the impact, Warren Fletcher suffered a fracture of the wrist that required emergency treatment,
immobilization, and ongoing orthopedic care. Our client has missed substantial time from work, has been restricted in
daily activities, and continues to experience pain, stiffness, and reduced grip strength. Medical records and billing
statements documenting this treatment are enclosed.
Liability in this matter is clear, and the damages are well documented. We therefore demand payment of $68,000.00
to resolve all claims arising from this accident against your insured. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the
date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are authorized to file a civil action
without further notice and to seek all damages available under the law, including costs and interest.
Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office.
Expert review: Katherine Moore, accident reconstructionist
Sincerely,
Kyle Sanders
Marshall & Dominguez LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
